headline: M2: 100 suitable benchmark observations assembled.
detail: Human suitability review is complete for the original 100 core evidence packets and the 22-case replacement set. The original pass produced 78 suitable observations; all 22 replacement records were also marked suitable, producing a 100-observation suitable pool. M2 now advances to historical-context assembly and human relationship adjudication before Benchmark v0.1 is frozen.
next_gate: Assemble historical context for the 100 suitable observations and complete human relationship adjudication before Benchmark v0.1 freeze.
public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, replacement packet contents, raw operational records, and case-level suitability decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
